protocol.name: oma_ahb_v1

description.summary: buffers the compositor allocates, shown without a copy

protocol.description:
Android only shows buffers from its own allocator (gralloc, AHardwareBuffer), and an app has no public way to wrap a dma-buf a client allocated into one. So here the compositor allocates: the client asks for a buffer of a size and format, gets a wl_buffer and the dma-buf with its pixels, renders into it (Vulkan: VK_EXT_external_memory_dma_buf with VK_EXT_image_drm_format_modifier), then attaches the wl_buffer and commits as with any other. The compositor puts the buffer on screen as it is, without copying it.
There is no implicit synchronization: the client's rendering must be finished before the commit. As with wl_shm, the client must not touch a buffer between commit and wl_buffer.release.
Private to OmaLauncher; it may change incompatibly while it's version 1.

entry.name: invalid_size
entry.summary: width or height out of range (1 to 16384)

request.name: allocate
request.description: Answered by allocated or failed for this wl_buffer. A failed one can't be attached (it attaches nothing) and only needs destroying.

arg.name: format
arg.summary: DRM fourcc, one of the format events

event.name: allocated
event.description: A single plane. modifier_hi and modifier_lo make the DRM format modifier of its layout, DRM_FORMAT_MOD_LINEAR (0) in version 1.

event.name: format
event.description: Sent for each format right after the allocator is bound: ABGR8888 and XBGR8888 (bytes R, G, B, A) always, ARGB8888 and XRGB8888 (bytes B, G, R, A) where the device's allocator has them and the system composes them safely (Adreno so far). The X formats are shown opaque, whatever is in their alpha.
